notes.title: Return to the Shadows – Version 1.0 Now Available!
notes.notes:
[p]Greetings Wanderers of the Backrooms,[/p][p]Today, we’re opening a special door into the past, a door that leads back to where it all began.[/p][p]We’re thrilled to announce that [b]Version 1.0[/b] of [i]Backrooms: Realm of Shadows[/i] is now [b]officially playable[/b] for all Steam users! This feature has been highly requested by long-time players, speedrunners, and lore hunters who wanted to revisit the earliest iteration of the game. [/p][hr][/hr][h3]What's Different in Version 1.0?[/h3][p]Version 1.0 represents the [i]very first public release[/i] of the game. It’s raw, unpolished, and eerie in ways the current version no longer is, and that’s part of its charm.[/p][p]Here’s what makes it unique:[/p][list][*][p][b]The Original Movement System[/b]
Before we refined and rebuilt the player controller, movement in Version 1.0 had its own pace, quirks, and flow. It’s back exactly as it was.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Classic Level Design[/b]
You’ll find early versions of levels that have since been redesigned or removed. Expect a more surreal, unpredictable atmosphere, complete with old lighting setups, asset placements, and layouts that were later overhauled.[/p][/*][*][p][b]The Original Note System[/b]
Before narrative integration was more seamless, notes played a bigger role in storytelling. The old system is back in its original form.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Legacy Systems Restored[/b]
Version 1.0 includes systems and mechanics that no longer exist in the modern game, some experimental, some chaotic, and all part of the game's early DNA.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]Important Notes & Recommendations[/h3][p]While we’re excited to offer this nostalgic option, there are a few important caveats to keep in mind:[/p][list][*][p][b]The Eternal Shadow DLC is NOT compatible[/b] with Version 1.0. You’ll need to return to the latest build to experience any content from the DLC.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Bugs and Balancing Issues[/b]
Version 1.0 is exactly as it was on release. This means you may encounter old bugs, balance problems, or features that no longer behave as expected. We’ve made [i]no changes[/i] to preserve its authenticity.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Recommended for Experienced Players Only[/b]
If you’re new to the game, we [b]strongly recommend starting with the current version[/b] for a more polished, stable, and balanced experience. Version 1.0 is best enjoyed by those who’ve already completed the game and want a deeper look at its history.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Steam-Only Feature[/b]
This feature is [b]only available on the Steam version[/b] of the game. Unfortunately, it is [b]not supported on the Epic Games Store[/b] at this time.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]How to Access Version 1.0 on Steam[/h3][p]To switch to Version 1.0:[/p][olist][*][p]Right-click on [i]Backrooms: Realm of Shadows[/i] in your Steam library.[/p][/*][*][p]Select [b]Properties[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Go to the [b]Betas[/b] tab.[/p][/*][*][p]Choose version1.0 from the dropdown list.[/p][/*][*][p]Close the window and allow Steam to update the game.[/p][/*][/olist][p]You can switch back to the latest version at any time using the same method.[/p][hr][/hr][p]We know many of you have a deep connection to this game, some of you were here since the very first build, reporting bugs, exploring hidden corners, and sharing your theories. This release is for you.[/p][p]Thank you for supporting [i]Backrooms: Realm of Shadows[/i] as it’s grown. From our earliest prototype to the full game we’ve built together today, your passion and feedback have shaped every update.[/p][p]We hope this walk down memory lane gives you a new perspective on how far we've come, and maybe a chill or two along the way.[/p][p][/p][p]Until Next Time![/p][p]— Cyprus Games[/p]

notes.title: Patch 3.0.0
notes.notes:
[h2]CONTENT[/h2]

[list]
[*] The Backrooms: Eternal Shadows are now available! (More Details below)
[*] Added a new Save Game System (More Details below)
[*] Added an Final Menu after you completed both Story Modes
[*] Added 2 New Easter Eggs you can get in the DLC Story Mode
[*] Added an Easter Egg viewer Option in the Final Menu
[*] Added Controller Support for the Menus
[*] Added a new Soundtrack to the Final Menu
[/list]


[h2]BACKROOMS: ETERNAL SHADOWS[/h2]

[list]
[*] Added the DLC Shop on Steam and Epic Games. Available for free.
[*] Added a new Button in the Story Mode Tab to let Players teleport to the new Story.
[/list]

[b]Note: To Play this Story Extension, you need to own the "Full Game" DLC that is also required for the Normal Story Mode.
Note 2: We recommend to complete the Normal Story mode first before playing the Story Extension.[/b]


[h2]SAVE GAME REWORK[/h2]

[list]
[*] Added a New Save Game System
[*] Now Players can only select "New Game" or "Load Game". Players can no longer select on which Level they want to Spawn.
[*] Because the System is new, every Player needs to Play from the beginning again (or should. To Unlock the Final Menu they also need to complete the Normal Story Mode again after this Patch in order to unlock it)
[/list]


[h2]LEVEL CHANGES[/h2]

[list]
[*] Removed all Notes from the previous Levels because we dont need them anymore
[*] Replaced the Computer in Level "THE END" with a Keypad
[/list]


[h2]BALANCE CHANGES[/h2]

[list]
[*] Changed the Movement Speed from Bacteria in Level 0
[*] Slightly Increased the Generator Repair Speed in the TERROR HOTEL
[/list]


[h2]BUG FIXES[/h2]

[list]
[*] Fixed an Issue that caused to not get the Easter Eggs Rewards when collecting them (THE GHOST, THE STONE)
[*] Fixed an Issue that caused to not get any Coins when completing Levels
[*] Fixed an Issue where players got an Fatal Crash
[*] Fixed an Issue that some Levels where unplayable
[*] Fixed an Issue that the Music Volume was not changing when changed in the Settings Menu
[/list]

notes.title: Version 3.0 - What to expect
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone,

Its time for a new Dev Blog. This Time we will talk about everything thats coming with the next Patch. The Next Patch is going to be a big one. Version 3.0 will feature new Level Changes aswell as the DLC.
Lets talk about the DLC First.


[h2]BACKROOMS: ETERNAL SHADOWS - WHAT TO EXPECT[/h2]

Journey back into the Backrooms and try to find the Exit this Time. The DLC will feature new Levels, aswell as old ones that are making their way back. The DLC will wrap up the Backrooms Story for our Game. So before playing the DLC we are highly recommending Playing the Normal Story first. Also here is an Important Announcement: [b]The DLC: Backrooms Eternal Shadows will be available for Free![/b]
The Only thing you need to own is the "Full Game" DLC that is also required for the Normal Story Mode.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43678707/80f74bb64222ff7eb519566730bad20214070089.png[/img]


[h2]LEVEL CHANGES[/h2]

[h3]THE END[/h3]

In Level The End we are changing one Thing that got reported to us serveral Times.
After this Patch, you no longer need to go to the Computer to put in the PIN. Now you need to go to the Keypad and enter the PIN there. This will fix several Bugs in this Level.


[h3]LEVEL 188[/h3]

Also here, we only removed one Thing from the Level to make it better.
After this Patch, you no longer need to "put" the Numbers to open the first Door.
The First Door is now Automatically open. For the Second Door you still need to find the Key.


[h3]OTHER LEVEL CHANGES[/h3]

We removed all Notes from the Levels as these are no longer required. Also the Notes where not compatible with Gamepad so we deceided to remove the Notes from our Game.



[h1]SAVE GAME CHANGES[/h1]

We got several reports that Players are getting teleported back to the Main Menu after hitting "Start Game". This only happens if you didnt set a Level from the Drop Down Menu. To make it easier for the Players to start and Load a Game we are introducing a new Save Game Function.
After this Patch you can Start a New Game that will override your current Save or you can Load the Game from the Save you already have and continue Playing.


This is everything we have for you Today.
We are happy to announce that this Patch including the DLC will release late March! Stay Tuned for more Infos!

notes.title: Level Reworks and Changes for the Next Update
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone!

Welcome back to another Dev Blog.
Today we want to show you what will come to the Next Update.
The Next Update will focuse on 2 Level Reworks and some Level Changes.
Lets get started!


[h1]LEVEL REWORKS[/h1]

[h2]LEVEL 96[/h2]

In the current Version of Level 96 you have to find the "Save House" to Escape. However we wanted to change that. Thats not because the current Level 96 is too Easy, its also not balanced enough.
The New Level 96 will feature only 1 Escape Way. Find the Open House around the Level to Escape. Also to make it a little bit harder, we added a Day and Night System to this Level and also some better Hills.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43678707/c79be08bcb08cce062aab2bcfec10a0a23c41bdd.png[/img]


[h2]ELECTRICAL STATION[/h2]

The current Version of the Electrical Station is ok, but the Design of the Level is not what where intended for the Backrooms. So the New Version of this Level will feature some new Looking Models and a new "Tunnel Network".
Also its a little bit clearer on how to Escape from this Level.
We also removed the PIN Puzzle from this Level.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43678707/e15e17afe6c416c7d302e0bfc099bc7b831fef8a.png[/img]


[h2]NEW SOUNDTRACK[/h2]

With this Patch we also added a New Soundtrack to the Game. The Poolrooms are getting their own Music! So when the Update goes Online you will hear a new Music when playing the Poolrooms Level!
We cant wait to see what you think about it.



We also changed some smaller things on other Levels that will be revealed when we share the Patch Notes. This Patch will go Online in February. Stay Tuned!


Until next Time

notes.title: CHANGES COMING TO THE FULL RELEASE
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

The Playtest is now over and here are the Changes we will do before we will release the game.
Thanks again to everyone who participated in the Beta and gived us Feedback.
The Changes are based on your Feedback you gave us.



[h2]CHANGES FROM BETA TO FULL RELEASE[/h2]

[list]
[*] To avoid confusion, Sub Layer levels will unlocked after the Main Story
[*] We will add Notes to the Lobby Buttons to know which Button does what
[*] We will fix an Issue that is causing when selecting a Level, it will not recognis that you selected a Level
[*] We will change the Flashlight Light Material and also change the Flashlight Hotkey from T to F
[*] We will add an Flashlight Turn On and Off Sound
[*] We will add an Controls Menu in the Settings Menu
[*] We will change some Tiles in Level 0
[*] We are aware of an Issue that the Level 0 Monster cant pass between the Pitfalls. We will fix this with the Full Release
[*] We will add an Option to turn on a VHS Effect and to disable it
[*] We will add an Hotkey that shows a Progressbar on which Status your Stamina is
[*] We will fix the Sound Effects Option Slider
[*] We will reduce the Character Run Speed a little bit
[*] We will reduce the Level 0 Entity Chase Speed a little bit
[*] We will revamp Level 1. When the Full Version Releases, the Smiler Entity can move and chase the Player. The Key will spawn with the Start of the Player and can be picked up anytime to run to the Exit. The Key will no longer despawn.
[*] We will add a Start Level before the Backrooms to know how you landed in the Backrooms
[*] We will add an "Exit Sign" to Level 1-2 to know where the Exit Opens once all Valves are activated
[*] We will add an Note at the beginning from Level 1-2 to know what to do in this Level
[*] We will reduce the Camera Shake
[/list]
